shareholding_requirement_ceo_source: PAGE 74: "Minimum share ownership requirements are set at three times executive director base salary. Shares that count towards the requirements include any shares held unencumbered by an executive director, plus any shares vested but held, and any shares unvested but not subject to future performance conditions. This requirement may be built up over five years from appointment. Executive directors will be required to hold shares exceeding 100% of salary (or, if lower, their actual shareholding) for two years post-employment. Holding and vesting periods for all equity awards will be adhered to post-employment."

See more details in the Remuneration Report on page 73."
